newsitem.title: USA: APAC TeleServices inks Farmers Ins pact.
newsitem.headline: APAC TeleServices inks Farmers Ins pact.

text.p: APAC TeleServices Inc said on Monday it signed an agreement with Farmers Insurance, a unit of Farmers Group, for after-hours claims processing services.

APAC said it will handle after-hours telephone claims services for Farmers' policyholders and provide telephone coverage for natural catastrophes. Both companies said the agreement will be expanded in the future.
APAC operates 62 call centers in 19 states.
Its shares were trading down 10/16 Monday at 38-15/16.
